title: Hikaru Shida’s reign & Britt Baker’s ascent
summary: Shida anchors the women’s division before Baker wins the championship and becomes its new focal point.

chapters.title: Shida begins her reign
chapters.result: Shida defeats Nyla Rose in a no-disqualification title match.
chapters.context: The victory starts Shida’s first championship reign.

chapters.title: Baker takes the championship
chapters.result: Baker defeats Shida for the Women’s World Championship.
chapters.context: Shida’s long reign ends as Baker reaches the top of the division.
